csv_agency: City of Colonial Heights Purchasing Dept
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Colonial Heights Virginia hereby solicits qualified and interested firms to submit proposals and statements of qualifications for Architectural and Engineering Services, on an as-required basis, for the City of Colonial Heights Virginia. The Architect/Engineer will provide professional services, which may include: site and building planning, programming of space needs, space planning, building and landscape architecture, interior design, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, civil, design of roof repairs and/or replacements, life-cycle costing, energy modeling and any surveying or related services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Energy Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering
